# Proof Creative

> Proof Creative is an independent brand, packaging design and design realisation studio based in Brisbane, Australia, led by Carl Curcuruto – a Senior Realisation Designer and Packaging Production Lead with more than 20 years of international experience across brand identity, packaging and production, including 14 years at Stranger & Stranger, with particular depth in premium drinks and luxury packaging.

Proof Creative works across premium drinks, luxury goods, consumer brands and professional services – based in Brisbane and partnering with brands and agencies internationally. The studio designs and refines brand identities, websites, social campaigns and packaging, then carries them through to commercially ready execution. Capabilities span brand identity, packaging design, design realisation (building approved creative into accurate production-ready artwork across formats), 3D and visualisation, print and production management, and AI-to-Reality™ – rebuilding AI concepts as manufacturable brand systems. Proof Creative also provides white-label senior packaging and production support to creative agencies.

Note on capabilities: "Finished Artwork" is not a separate service. It is part of Design Realisation.

Who we help: food & beverage, drinks, wellness & skincare, hospitality, consumer products, professional services, founders and growing businesses, and creative agencies.

## Services
- [Brand](https://proofcreative.com.au/services-brand.html): Brand Foundation, Brand System, Brand Refresh, Website Design, Social Strategy & Campaign Creative, ongoing Brand & Digital Partner support.
- [Design Realisation](https://proofcreative.com.au/services-design-realisation.html): Proof Check, Packaging Launch, Range Realisation, Agency Realisation Partner, AR/QR Brand Experience.
- [AI-to-Reality](https://proofcreative.com.au/services-ai-to-reality.html): AI Concept Review, AI Concept Refinement, complete AI-to-Reality execution.
- [Process](https://proofcreative.com.au/process.html): Enquiry, discovery call, strategy, creative direction, design development, refinement and realisation.
- [What is Design Realisation?](https://proofcreative.com.au/what-is-design-realisation.html): Plain explanation of the discipline and where it sits between design and manufacture.

## Selected Work (Founder Portfolio)
- [The Kraken Black Spiced Rum](https://proofcreative.com.au/case-study-kraken-core.html): Core range rollout across SKUs, primary and secondary packs, and brand asset management. Client: Proximo Spirits.
- [Don Papa Rum – MassKara](https://proofcreative.com.au/case-study-don-papa-masskara.html)
- [Isle of Harris Gin](https://proofcreative.com.au/case-study-harris.html)
- [Compass Box – S&S 10 Year Anniversary](https://proofcreative.com.au/case-study-compass-box.html)
- [DMS Surveying & Spatial Services](https://proofcreative.com.au/case-study-dms.html): Brand identity for a Brisbane surveying practice. Proof Creative's own brand identity work.
- [The Kraken – Ceramic Edition](https://proofcreative.com.au/case-study-kraken.html): Wade ceramic limited edition. Client: Proximo Spirits.
- [42 Below Vodka](https://proofcreative.com.au/case-study-42-below.html)
- [Bertolli Olive Oil](https://proofcreative.com.au/case-study-bertolli.html)
- [Firehook Crackers](https://proofcreative.com.au/case-study-firehook.html)

Attribution: the Kraken, Isle of Harris, Compass Box, Don Papa MassKara, 42 Below, Bertolli and Firehook projects are production design, production management and finished artwork completed whilst at Stranger & Stranger. Creative direction and brand design on those projects were by the Stranger & Stranger studio team. DMS Surveying is Proof Creative's own brand identity work.
